gaps.sentence: His sudden ___ (RESIGN) surprised everyone in the department.
gaps.hint: noun: act of leaving a job

gaps.sentence: The coach criticised the team's lack of ___ (DISCIPLINE).
gaps.explanation: 'Lack of discipline' — the noun is required after 'lack of'.
'Championship victory' — the title/contest, not the person.

gaps.sentence: He lost his ___ (CONFIDENT) after the failure.
He spoke ___ (CONFIDENT) in front of the camera.

gaps.hint: noun: the state of being free from rule
gaps.explanation: 'Gain independence' = become self-governing; the noun form follows the verb.

gaps.sentence: His ___ (REFUSE) to cooperate stalled the negotiations.
Rising sea levels ___ (THREAT) the very existence of the island.
gaps.explanation: A main verb is needed after the plural subject: threaten.
